about: Texts of old maps in their code page, for app/src/lib/formats/codepage.test.ts and crates/w3proj/src/lossless.rs. read: a string's bytes (hex), its lossless text (lossless.ts / lossless.rs) and what an editor shows with the code page chosen; a byte the code page can't read stays its private-use character (U+10FF00 + byte). typed: what a user typed, the lossless text the editor stores for it (codepage.ts storeText) and the bytes that text packs to.
